product.name: Monoprice Blackbird Pro WiHD 60GHz Uncompressed Wireless Professional Video Extender with up to 30 meter range
product.description: This Blackbird™ WiHD™ Wireless HDMI® Extender uses a 60GHz carrier frequency and can transmit uncompressed HDMI signals to distances up to 98 feet (30 meters) with near zero latency. It supports HDMI resolutions up to 4K@30Hz (YCbCr 4:2:2), including 1080p@60Hz (YCbCr 4:4:4) and 3D video. It supports 7.1‑channel High Bit Rate lossless digital audio formats, including Dolby TrueHD™ and DTS‑HD Master Audio™. It is fully compliant with the HDMI 1.4b, HDCP™ 2.2, and WiHD™ 1.1 standards and supports the Consumer Electronic Control (CEC) feature. WirelessUp to 98ftUSB‑PoweredWireless: Forget about long HDMI®, network, or coaxial cables. As long as you have access to power, you can wirelessly extend full HD HDMI video without the need for long, expensive runs of copper.Up to 98ft: Wirelessly extend 4K@30Hz video to distances up to 98 feet (30 meters).USB‑Powered: Rather than using a proprietary AC power adapter, which can get lost in a move and which requires an open AC power socket, it uses a basic USB connection for its power.
